title: The Weaving of Our Pasts
subtitle: Go and seek the Golden Fleece. In the land of endless peace.

items.text: The Weaving of Our Pasts
Lava Tube, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: *panting*
The mist begins to rise.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes, I've definitely seen it before. This is the same mist from the lake in my suitcase.
The deeper she ventures into the sanctuary, the thicker the mist grows, until each step feels meaningless and indistinct.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Which way did I come from?
Amidst the endlessness, a single golden thread drifts down.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: A thread ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I can't seem to grasp it. It's like a wisp of smoke.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Who's there?
Investigating the source of the sound. At the far edge of the hazy mist, the faint outline of a rotating golden ring emerges.
A familiar sight. Just as it was millennia ago. Just as it was decades past. Just as it appeared yesterday.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: A spinner at the Wheel. I've seen this before, but where?
Yet nothing comes to mind.
A soft song tugs at the thread, guiding the way forward—the answers lie just ahead.
Come. Move forward. Step closer.
Until the memories deep within the mist are within reach.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What have I forgotten?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Where do things go when we forget them?
Are you looking for this?
A hat. A deep indigo hat tied with a soft teal ribbon.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, yes, my hat. Thank you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I didn't even realize it was gone.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's ever so important to me. Where did you find it?
Along the path you took.
She points into the distance. The fierce summer light blurs her view of the SPDM.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Must've been another one of Joseph's pranks. Thank you for bringing it back to me.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you a new staff member in the school? I don't believe I've seen you before.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Though, strangely, I feel as though we've met before, a long time ago.
Heh-heh ...
A breeze sweeps by, carrying the trailing notes of a laugh.
We will see more of one another in the time to come.
The wind rustles through her hair, then nothing.
She looks down at her empty hands.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: When did that happen?
The golden thread urges her onward, while the song at the other end lingers.
Sail, sail free,
my heart and light.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wave your home a last goodbye.
Unnoticed, the Wheel spins out a length of thread.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wave your home a last goodbye.

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: What's that song you're singing, Vertin?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's a song I heard in a dream.

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: I dream about songs too—about my mom and dad singing them to me. They sing and say all kinds of stuff, but when I wake up, I can't seem to remember any of it.

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: It's nice that you remember, though. What was your dream about?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm not sure. I don't think I really dream at all.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But sometimes, just before I fall asleep, I feel someone sit beside me. She strokes my hair and sings this song.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But when I wake up, there's nobody there.

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: That doesn't seem like a dream to me. Maybe one of the instructors comes to check on you at night?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I don't think so. Even though I don't remember her face, I know she isn't one of the instructors because I feel like I know her.

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: It sounds like a fairy tale. A lady singing by your bed at night.

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: Do you remember anything else?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Not really. I'm not even sure if she's real.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But when she looks at me, it feels warm, like being in the sun, like we are now.
She turns, reaching out as if to grasp the sun.
At the edge of her vision, she catches a glimpse of that familiar silhouette.

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: Vertin?
But when she looks, there are only fallen leaves drifting away from the forest's edge.
So sleep my baby, grow bright, grow firm.
The Wheel completes another rotation. And the song falls silent.
That voice ... Vertin?
Vertin ...
The same dream again. No, is it even a dream?
It feels different today. The familiar warmth of song is absent, replaced by a chilled silence.
Cool fingertips trace across brows, nose, cheeks, lips, mapping every contour.
At last, that hand comes to rest over her eyes.
My child ...
Tread the path you must tread, turn the page you must turn,
and seek the answer you must seek.
A kiss falls on her forehead, cold liquid trailing after it like rain.
This is the final farewell.
The hand lifts from her eyes. The figure at her bedside rises and leaves without even a word.
No! She can't leave like this!
Wake up. Shake off this warm, alluring slumber. Rise up to meet reality, harsh, but true. Try to catch that scattering wisp of wind.
Wake up!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Stay with me—
The scene in her memory dissolves.
And overlapping with that figure she's been chasing is a face filled with concern.
Are you alright, child?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Dr. Dores?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No. That isn't right.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Who are you? Marta, Bessmert, Urd?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I'm Dr. Dores. My pen name is indeed "Urd."

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I might have published a few stories under that name, but I've never spoken of it to anyone. How did you come to know it was me?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I ... I've been looking for you for a long time. I've followed your trail across the world.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Ah. I can only imagine how hard such a journey must have been for you, dear child.
Dores's hand rests upon her head, stirring a warmth thick with nostalgia.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: But I'm afraid the other names you mentioned don't belong to me.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: You're Vertin, aren't you? I believe we met briefly in São Paulo.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: But tell me, how did you come to be here?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm ... I'm here for you, and to stop Manus Vindictae's ritual.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Manus Vindictae? Forgive me, child. I'm afraid I'm not sure what you mean.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: *steadying breath* Allow me to explain.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm an arcanist of the St. Pavlov Foundation. We have intel that a dangerously powerful ritual is soon to be performed here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the interest of your own safety, I must ask you to come with me to the Foundation headquarters.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I will go with you, but not just yet.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: There is something I must finish—these threads I'm spinning.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Threads?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Yes. Others don't seem to see them, but I do.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: It's strange. I don't know what they are, but I know how to spin them. Does that sound ridiculous to you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Not at all. In fact, I can see them too.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But perhaps we should do it together, later, when the danger has subsided.
Slowly, firmly, Dores shakes her head.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: There may not be a "later." I must finish this now.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is this worth more than your life?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I believe it is.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: These threads must be spun so the all-ruling law may be woven.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: That is my purpose—my calling. That is why I was led here.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: That's why you're here too, is it not? To answer your calling?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: My calling? You mean—

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: My child. I may be blind of sight, but my senses are clear.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: This is a path you must tread, a page you must turn.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: This is the answer you must seek.
The words sound familiar.
No more is said. Dores turns away, hands returning to the spindle.
And in that instant, her figure merges with memories of the past.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No ...
She hears herself cry out in desperation. But the Spinning Wheel has already begun to turn.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, stay with me—

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mum!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is ...?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Vertin?
The water rises.
More and more water rises.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: How can this be?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: No. This can't be my calling.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Tides run in blind by their ever-be routine,

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Staining that Heaven with obscene calamity.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: The breaker of death's shackles shall rule us all,

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: From this day forth, and evermore.

items.speaker: Believers & Animus
items.text: The blessing of the coming age is near. And, humbly, we kneel to receive such grace.

items.speaker: Believers & Animus
items.text: O Glorious One, walk the Earth again—

items.speaker: Believers & Animus
items.text: Shape this land with your mighty, vengeful hands!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Heh. Ms. Urd. We owe you our thanks for starting the ritual.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: At last, we are no longer lost.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: For the Guiding One is risen!
TO BE CONTINUED…
